newsitem.title: UK: UK public sector pay to increase 3.2-3.4 pct - FT.
newsitem.headline: UK public sector pay to increase 3.2-3.4 pct - FT.

text.p: British doctors, nurses, teachers and soldiers are set to receive pay rises between 3.2 and 3.4 percent, above what can be afforded under next year's public spending limits, the Financial Times reported.
The FT said the five main pay review bodies have made recommendations covering 1.3 million public sector workers but these will not be published until the end of next week.

Under pressure from Chancellor of the Exchequer Kenneth Clarke, these bodies are proposing pay rises below last year's 4.0 percent increase but above what was allocated in November's budget, the newspaper said.
The pay rises are expected to be staggered.
